lines.en: label day288:
scene hallnoonwinter
I make my way down the hall after spending a short while in my office with Makoto, trying to figure out a little more information about why it’s suddenly okay for me to teach more students.
lines.zh: 和 Makoto 在办公室待了一会儿之后，我沿着走廊往外走，想再弄清楚一点：为什么突然之间我就能带更多学生了。

lines.en: The rich girl, Touka, makes sense considering that I somehow managed to leave a good impression on her mother by...
lines.zh: 那个富家女 Touka 倒是说得通——毕竟我不知怎么就给她母亲留下了好印象，靠的是……

lines.en: Audibly having sex with a [teenage]girl in the room next door to her all night?
lines.zh: 整夜在她隔壁的房间里和一个[teenage]女孩做爱，还声音大到她都听得见？

lines.en: You’d think something like that would raise a red flag, but apparently not.
lines.zh: 换谁都会觉得这种事该亮红灯吧，但显然没有。

lines.en: Oh well. They’re probably just a weird family.
lines.zh: 算了。大概只是那家人比较怪。

lines.en: The second girl, on the other hand, is the one we still can’t figure anything out for.
lines.zh: 至于第二个女孩，我们至今还是一无所获。

lines.en: Her previous teachers wouldn’t even speak with me, which makes me worry that it’s going to be another Yumi-type situation.
lines.zh: 她以前的老师连话都不肯跟我说，让我忍不住担心这会是又一个 Yumi 那种情况。

lines.en: But hey, if it is, I guess that will keep one more desk free most days. So I’m fine with it in that regard.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果真是那样，至少多数时候又空出一张桌子。从这个角度看我也没什么意见。

lines.en: : No way! Already?! That’s so awesome!
lines.zh: : 不会吧！这么快？！太棒了！

lines.en: : Hahah, yeah...I’m a little surprised too.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈，是啊……我也挺意外的。

lines.en: I hear two familiar voices crawling out from around the corner and decide to get myself involved in time that I’m sure both of them would rather spend alone.
lines.zh: 我听见两个熟悉的声音从拐角那头冒出来，于是决定插上一脚——打搅一段我敢肯定她们俩都更想单独度过的时间。

lines.en: Or at least time {i}one of them{/i} would rather spend alone. The other one, I’m not so sure of yet.
lines.zh: 至少{i}其中一个{/i}更想单独度过吧。另一个嘛，我还说不准。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall1
: Oh, hey! Are you done with your office hours already?
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿！你答疑时间已经结束啦？

lines.en: : Yo. Welcome to...what is apparently our new hang out spot.
lines.zh: : 哟。欢迎来到……看来是我们新的据点了。

lines.en: : Hey. It’s looking pretty lively over here today.
lines.zh: : 嘿。今天这边挺热闹啊。

lines.en: : Otoha’s parents just approved her staying in the dorms, so we’re having a sort of...impromptu celebration.
lines.zh: : Otoha 的父母刚刚同意她住进宿舍了，所以我们在办一个……算是即兴庆祝吧。

lines.en: : In the hallway? Shouldn’t you be out at like, a restaurant or something? Or even the cafe?
lines.zh: : 在走廊里？你们难道不该去个餐厅什么的？哪怕是咖啡馆也行啊。

lines.en: : Oh dear. We’re not getting in trouble for loitering, are we?
lines.zh: : 哎呀呀。我们该不会因为游荡挨骂吧？

lines.en: : No way. Sensei’s only ever given detention to Yumi and that’s just cause she’s a bitch.
lines.zh: : 不可能。Sensei 只给过 Yumi 留堂，而且那纯粹是因为她是个婊子。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall2
: Yumi? Is there someone in our class with that name?
lines.zh: : Yumi？我们班有叫这个名字的人吗？

lines.en: : Barely. She just shows up every once in a while to say mean things to Futaba and then leave.
lines.zh: : 勉强算吧。她只是偶尔冒个头，对 Futaba 说几句难听的，然后就走了。

lines.en: : Why would anyone ever say anything mean to Futaba? She’s like, the nicest girl I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 怎么会有人对 Futaba 说难听的话？她简直是我见过最温柔的女生了。

lines.en: : Where {i}is{/i} this Yumi character, by the way? I’m very eager to meet her and knock her off her high horse.
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，这个 Yumi 人在哪儿？我可{i}是{/i}非常想会会她，把她从高头大马上拽下来。

lines.en: : Probably wandering around the city somewhere.
lines.zh: : 大概在城里什么地方闲逛吧。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’d call her horse {i}high{/i}, though. She has some stuff she’s dealing with as well.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得她那匹马也没多{i}高{/i}。她自己也有要应付的事。

lines.en: : And that excuses her for all of the horrible things she’s said to my best friend?
lines.zh: : 那就能抵消她对我最好的朋友说过的那些难听的话了？

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall3
: Nodoka...you don’t have to do anything. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : Nodoka……你不用做什么的。我没事。

lines.en: : Of course it doesn’t excuse her. But I’d feel a little bad if someone were to bully her as well after hearing some of what she’s been through.
lines.zh: : 当然抵消不了。不过听了她的一些经历，如果还有人去欺负她，我多少会有点过意不去。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall4
: Wait, did you actually {i}learn{/i} something about Yumi, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei，你真{i}打听到{/i} Yumi 的什么事了？

lines.en: : Has anyone other than like...Chika ever done that before?
lines.zh: : 除了……Chika 之外，还有人做到过吗？

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall5
: Waaaaait...I knew that girl was familiar.
lines.zh: : 等——等一下……我就说那个女孩眼熟。

lines.en: : Chika’s the one you have a crush on, right? She’s the reason you didn’t want to meet at the mall that one time.
lines.zh: : Chika 就是你暗恋的那个吧？那次你不想在商场碰面就是因为她。

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Dude, it’s fine. Tell me more about her.
lines.zh: : 哥们，没事的。再多跟我说说她。

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t really know if...that’s something I want to talk about right now...
lines.zh: : 呃……我也不确定……我现在想不想聊这个……

lines.en: : Regardless of exactly what you found out about this girl, I don’t intend to just let her walk all over my friend.
lines.zh: : 不管你到底打听到了这姑娘的什么，我都不打算任由她踩着我朋友。

lines.en: : Is she okay, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 她还好吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Who, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 谁，Yumi？

lines.en: : Yeah. She’s Yumi. She’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她就是 Yumi 嘛。她会没事的。

lines.en: : I’m kind of interested in hearing what Nodoka plans to do to her, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我还挺想听听 Nodoka 打算拿她怎么办。

lines.en: : I have to say, I’m pretty sure a fight wouldn’t exactly go in your favor.
lines.zh: : 我得说，我敢肯定真打起来你未必占得了便宜。

lines.en: : I don’t intend to fight her. I just want to have a little talk with her and inform her of exactly how amazing this girl is.
lines.zh: : 我没打算跟她动手。我只是想跟她小小地谈一谈，让她好好知道这姑娘有多么了不起。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall6
: Thank you, but...I’m nowhere near amazing.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，不过……我根本算不上什么了不起。

lines.en: : There’s still plenty of stuff I have to work on...
lines.zh: : 我要改的地方还有很多……

lines.en: : Oh? Anything I can help with?
lines.zh: : 哦？有什么我能帮上忙的吗？

lines.en: : Not unless you want to start going to the gym.
lines.zh: : 除非你打算开始去健身房。

lines.en: : Oof.
: Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 行啊。为什么不呢？

lines.en: : I know you’re aware of how much I hate physical activity but, if it’s for you, I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 你知道我有多讨厌体力活动，不过如果是为了你，我会尽力的。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall7
: Oh! Gym talk! I’m part of this!
lines.zh: : 哦！健身房话题！这我得算一份！

lines.en: : Are we finally going to start working out?
lines.zh: : 我们终于要开始锻炼了吗？

lines.en: : If that’s okay with you...I think I’d like to.
lines.zh: : 如果你们不介意的话……我想试试。

lines.en: : There’s only so long until the beach trip and...even if it’s the winter and there won't be any bathing suits, I’d like to look a little...slimmer.
lines.zh: : 离海滩之行也没多久了，而且……虽然现在是冬天、也穿不上泳衣，我还是想看起来……瘦一点。

lines.en: : You look great, Futaba. But if that’s what will make you happy, I’ll come too.
lines.zh: : 你现在就很好看啊，Futaba。不过如果这样能让你开心，我也一起去。

lines.en: : We can all go as a group. It’ll be fun.
lines.zh: : 我们大家一起去。会很好玩的。

lines.en: : Will you be joining us as well, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei 也会一起来吗？

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall8
: Wait! I’ll be...a lot less comfortable if he comes! And...the dorm gym can only fit...four people so...
lines.zh: : 等等！他来的话我会……很不自在的！而且……宿舍健身房只容得下……四个人，所以……

lines.en: : What kind of gym only fits four people?
lines.zh: : 什么样的健身房只容得下四个人啊？

lines.en: : None, clearly. Futaba is just afraid of causing you to get aroused by the swaying of her voluptuous breasts as she rides the elliptical.
lines.zh: : 显然没有。Futaba 只是怕她踩椭圆机时，那对丰乳晃来晃去会让你起反应。

lines.en: : Hot.
lines.zh: : 好辣。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you think you’d be able to keep your eyes off of Futaba as her boobs go crazy and stuff?
lines.zh: : Sensei，Futaba 的奶子晃得乱七八糟的时候，你觉得你能把眼睛挪开吗？

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall9
: Ugh...
: First off, no.
lines.zh: : 首先，不能。

lines.en: : Second, I don’t really want to go to the gym.
lines.zh: : 其次，我也不是很想去健身房。

lines.en: : But you’ll get to see all of us in form fitting clothes and leggings and stuff.
lines.zh: : 但你能看到我们所有人穿紧身衣和打底裤什么的啊。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe I want to go to the gym.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许我是想去健身房。

lines.en: : There’s the Sensei I know.
lines.zh: : 这才是我认识的 Sensei。

lines.en: : Thinking with his penis instead of his heart like the true asshole he is.
lines.zh: : 用他的鸡巴而不是心思考，真不愧是他这个混蛋。

lines.en: : You know, the more I think about it, the more I realize that Rin might actually be the weird one and you might be totally normal, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢，我越想越觉得，Rin 可能才是那个奇怪的人，而你完全很正常，Sensei。

lines.en: : I can assure you that we’re both equally weird.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我们俩一样奇怪。

lines.en: : I haven’t known him for very long, but I think I would give the edge to Sensei in a “weirdness” contest.
lines.zh: : 我认识他的时间不长，不过要真是比谁更「怪」，我觉得 Sensei 略胜一筹。

lines.en: : Especially after what happened between us in the janitor’s closet during lunch today.
lines.zh: : 尤其是今天午休在保洁柜里、发生在我们之间的那件事之后。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall10
: J-Janitor’s closet?!
lines.zh: : 保——保洁柜？！

lines.en: : Yes. Nodoka is extremely good with her hands.
lines.zh: : 对。Nodoka 的手上功夫相当了得。

lines.en: : Those were actually my feet. That’s just how good I am.
lines.zh: : 其实那是我的脚。我就是这么厉害。

lines.en: : Uhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃……

lines.en: : Sensei! She literally {i}just{/i} transferred in!
lines.zh: : Sensei！她可是{i}刚{/i}转来啊！

lines.en: : The body wants what the body wants.
lines.zh: : 身体想要什么，身体就想要什么。

lines.en: : Okay, before this goes any further and anyone believes us, I want to confirm that there was no janitor’s closet.
lines.zh: : 好了，在继续下去、在有人信以为真之前，我要确认一下：根本没有保洁柜这回事。

lines.en: : Oh, that’s right. I spent lunch on the rooftop today. I completely mixed those two things up.
lines.zh: : 哦对了。今天午休我是在天台上过的。我彻底把这两件事搞混了。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall11
: You two are...quite interesting together.
lines.zh: : 你们两个……凑一块儿还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : He’s like the tall, handsome father I never had.
lines.zh: : 他就像我从未拥有过的那个高大英俊的父亲。

lines.en: : But if I’m your father, then why would we spend lunch in the-
lines.zh: : 可如果我是你父亲，那我们为什么要在午休时——

lines.en: : Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。

lines.en: : Awwwww, you remembered my [incest] kink. That’s so sweet.
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊，你记得我的[incest]怪癖。真是太贴心了。

lines.en: : This story got a lot less exciting as soon as I realized it didn’t actually happen.
lines.zh: : 我一发现这事根本没发生过，这个故事就一下子没劲了。

lines.en: : Ooooookay, I’m gonna go out on a limb here and change the topic since I don’t really want to talk about [incest] with my teacher.
lines.zh: : 好——好吧，我冒个险换个话题，因为我实在不想跟我的老师聊[incest]。

lines.en: : Or...anyone, really.
lines.zh: : 或者说……跟任何人都不想。

lines.en: : Don’t listen to Otoha. She secretly pines for a little brother to fully devote herself to.
lines.zh: : 别听 Otoha 的。她其实暗暗渴望有个弟弟，好把自己完全奉献给他。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall12
: Where would you even come up with an idea like that?!
lines.zh: : 你到底从哪儿想出这种点子的？！

lines.en: : The same place I came up with this idea-
lines.zh: : 跟我冒出这个点子的地方一样——

lines.en: : No! I’m supposed to change the topic! You’re just going to pick something weird again!
lines.zh: : 不！该换话题的是我！你肯定又要挑个奇怪的东西！

lines.en: : Not at all. I’m just going to invite Sensei to the grand opening of our shared bedroom.
lines.zh: : 才不会。我只是想邀请 Sensei 来参加我们合住宿间的落成典礼。

lines.en: : And I am going to happily accept.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意接受。

lines.en: : See?! Weird!
lines.zh: : 你看？！奇怪吧！

lines.en: : It’s okay, Otoha. If you close your eyes, it’s like he’s not even there.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Otoha。你把眼睛闭上，就跟他不在这儿一样了。

lines.en: : He would still totally be there, though!
lines.zh: : 可他还是实打实地在那儿啊！

lines.en: : Do you not want me in your room, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你不想让我进你房间吗，Otoha？

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall13
: I’m more confused about why you’d want to come over in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我更搞不懂的是，你为什么一开始就想过来。

lines.en: : Like, don’t you have a girlfriend or something?
lines.zh: : 比如说，你不是有女朋友之类的吗？

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t allowed to have a girlfriend because his [niece] would get really mad and cut his penis off.
lines.zh: : Sensei 不能交女朋友，因为他[niece]会非常生气，把他的鸡巴剪掉。

lines.en: : Oooooh?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？

lines.en: : It’s not what you’re thinking, Nodoka...
lines.zh: : 不是你想的那样，Nodoka……

lines.en: Just kidding. It totally is.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。就是那样没错。

lines.en: I obviously can’t let anyone know that, though.
lines.zh: 不过我显然不能让任何人知道这件事。

lines.en: : I feel...very relieved to hear that for some reason.
lines.zh: : 不知道为什么……听到这个我松了一大口气。

lines.en: : Not the p-penis thing...but...the girlfriend thing...
lines.zh: : 不是鸡——鸡巴那件事……而是……女朋友那件事……

lines.en: : Good. And to answer your question, Otoha...no.
lines.zh: : 很好。回答你的问题，Otoha……没有。

lines.en: : But it’s not because I’m not allowed to have one.
lines.zh: : 但不是因为我不被允许交。

lines.en: : It’s because you like [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 是因为你喜欢[teenager]。

lines.en: : No. Well, yes. But that’s not why either.
lines.zh: : 不是。好吧，是。不过也不是因为这个。

lines.en: : I just don’t want one.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想要。

lines.en: : I’m not really relationship material.
lines.zh: : 我本来就不是谈恋爱的料。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall14
: I...don’t think that’s true, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得不是这样的，Sensei……

lines.en: : I think you would be really good at it if you wanted to be...
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果你想的话，你会做得很好的……

lines.en: : See, that’s the thing. I don’t {i}want{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 瞧，问题就在这儿。我不{i}想{/i}。

lines.en: : I mean, I guess it doesn’t really matter either way.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，反正怎样都无所谓吧。

lines.en: : It’s not like you’d have a hard time getting one or anything. You’re a pretty attractive guy.
lines.zh: : 你又不是找不到。你长得还挺帅的。

lines.en: : You should see him in a dimly lit janitor’s closet. That’s where he really shines.
lines.zh: : 你该看看他在光线昏暗的保洁柜里的样子。那才是他真正发光的地方。

lines.en: : I’m just...going to keep assuming that everything Nodoka says is a joke...
lines.zh: : 我以后就……继续当 Nodoka 说的每句话都是玩笑好了……

lines.en: : That is probably for the best.
lines.zh: : 这样大概最好。

lines.en: : On a completely serious note, I do think you should stop by soon.
lines.zh: : 说句完全正经的，我真心觉得你该尽快来一趟。

lines.en: : The four of us will be having a little move-in party, and it would be nice to have someone to move all of our belongings into the room while we drink tea and listen to sad music.
lines.zh: : 我们四个要办一个小型搬家派对，要是有人能帮我们把行李都搬进房间，我们好一边喝茶一边听伤感的音乐，那就再好不过了。

lines.en: : You know, for a second, I thought I was {i}actually{/i} being invited to party.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，有那么一瞬间，我{i}真{/i}以为自己是被邀请去派对的。

lines.en: : You are. Just as a mover and not a partygoer.
lines.zh: : 是啊。只不过身份是搬运工，不是客人。

lines.en: : I’ll save you some tea, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会给你留点茶的。

lines.en: : You can chill too, if you want. I don’t mind helping you move everything.
lines.zh: : 你也可以歇着的。我不介意帮你一起搬。

lines.en: : I’ve got a lot of heavier stuff so I’d feel really bad if you were just handling all of it on your own.
lines.zh: : 我有不少重东西，要是全让你一个人搬，我会很过意不去的。

lines.en: : Thank you, Otoha. Finally, someone who sees me as a human being and not a piece of meat.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Otoha。终于有人把我当人看，而不是一块肉了。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall15
: I don’t think you’re just meat!
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不只是一块肉啊！

lines.en: : In fact, I’ve never thought that even once!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我一次都没这么想过！

lines.en: : Boy am I glad I was only vegetarian for a few months.
lines.zh: : 还好我只吃素了几个月。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with being meat? Everybody likes meat.
lines.zh: : 是肉有什么不好？谁都喜欢肉啊。

lines.en: : Not Noriko. She’s still going strong on her diet from what I hear.
lines.zh: : Noriko 不喜欢。听说她还在坚持节食呢。

lines.en: : I can assure you that if I were meat, Noriko would break her diet immediately.
lines.zh: : 我可以保证，如果我是块肉，Noriko 会立刻破戒。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall16
: Hey, yeah! We haven’t talked about that yet!
lines.zh: : 嘿，对啊！这事儿我们还没聊过呢！

lines.en: : Have you really known her for that long, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你真的认识她那么久了吗？

lines.en: : I’m...a little more confused about how Maya reacted.
lines.zh: : 我……更搞不懂的是 Maya 的反应。

lines.en: : I could have sworn the two of you didn’t like each other very much.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为你们俩不太对付来着。

lines.en: : Ready to sit around and pretend we understand what’s going on, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 准备好了吗，坐下来假装在听懂发生了什么，Nodoka？

lines.en: : It smells like drama, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这儿有一股大戏的味道，Otoha。

lines.en: : Quick, let’s use this opportunity to grab our notebooks and jot down ideas for our next poems.
lines.zh: : 快，趁这个机会掏出笔记本，给下一首诗记点灵感。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about how Maya reacted and don’t worry about how long I’ve known Noriko for.
lines.zh: : 别操心 Maya 的反应，也别操心我认识 Noriko 多久了。

lines.en: : Neither of those things really concern either of you.
lines.zh: : 这两件事都跟你们无关。

lines.en: : Sure they do! You’re a big part of our lives, Sensei. Do you have any idea how often we talk about you?
lines.zh: : 当然有关！Sensei，你是我们生活里很重要的一部分。你知道我们有多常聊到你吗？

lines.en: : Like, at least twice a week.
lines.zh: : 比如，一周至少两次。

lines.en: : The way you started that made it sound like it was going to be a lot more...
lines.zh: : 你开头那语气，听着像是要多得多……

lines.en: : I said “at least!” Sometimes it {i}is{/i} more.
lines.zh: : 我说了「至少！」{i}有{/i}时候还更多呢。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall17
: I suppose I can look past Maya’s reaction since...it’s the only time I’ve ever seen her do anything like that...
lines.zh: : 我想我可以不去纠结 Maya 的反应，因为……那是我唯一一次见她做出那种事……

lines.en: : It...did stick out, though.
lines.zh: : 不过……确实很扎眼。

lines.en: : So...I wouldn’t be surprised if someone else made a bigger deal out of it.
lines.zh: : 所以……要是别人把这事闹得更大，我也不意外。

lines.en: : I feel like we missed something really juicy.
lines.zh: : 感觉我们错过了一段特别劲爆的内容。

lines.en: : But I guess if anyone could make things juicy, it's Noriko.
lines.zh: : 不过要说谁能把事情搞得劲爆，那大概就是 Noriko 了。

lines.en: : She carries this knife thing around and, this one time, she sliced her leg open so bad that there was blood literally everywhere.
lines.zh: : 她随身带着把刀之类的东西，有一次她把腿划开好大一条口子，血流得真的是到处都是。

lines.en: : She didn’t even think it was a big deal, though, and just kinda laughed it off. Girl is crazy.
lines.zh: : 可她压根没当回事，就这么一笑带过了。这姑娘真疯。

lines.en: : Good crazy, though. She’s fun.
lines.zh: : 不过是好的那种疯。她挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Yeah, nothing says fun like...blood everywhere.
lines.zh: : 是啊，还有比到处是血更「好玩」的呢。

lines.en: : Point is, Sensei, you know you can talk to us if you ever need an extra set of ears.
lines.zh: : 重点是，Sensei，你要是还需要多一双耳朵，随时可以跟我们说。

lines.en: : And we’ve got like, eight whole ears at the end of this hallway for you right now.
lines.zh: : 而现在这条走廊尽头，可有整整八只耳朵供你使唤。

lines.en: : It {i}does{/i} seem slightly unfair that you’re the sole individual designated to counseling all of us.
lines.zh: : 只由你一个人来负责开导我们所有人，{i}确实{/i}有点不公平。

lines.en: : Yeah, so I guess I’d be down to listen too if you want to open up to somebody you just met and have talked to like, less than five times.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以如果你想对一个刚认识、总共说过不到五次话的人敞开心扉，我也乐意听。

lines.en: : Is this an intervention or something? Why did everyone suddenly start offering me help?
lines.zh: : 这是某种干预治疗吗？怎么大家突然都开始要帮我了？

lines.en: : Just seems like things are gettin’ a little crazy for you. It would do you some good to take a load off in Otoha and Nodoka’s room sometime.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得你最近的日子有点太疯狂了。偶尔到 Otoha 和 Nodoka 房间里卸下担子，对你有好处。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall18
: Rin...you probably shouldn’t invite someone to someone else’s room...
lines.zh: : Rin……你不该替别人邀请人去别人的房间吧……

lines.en: : Didn’t we already decide it was okay, though?
lines.zh: : 可我们不是已经说好没问题了吗？

lines.en: : Still...it’s the...principle of actually doing that.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说……可这……这原则上不合适。

lines.en: : Screw it, yeah. Come chill with us.
lines.zh: : 管他呢，行吧。来跟我们混吧。

lines.en: : If you think it’s fun hanging out and listening to music with a bunch of [teenage]girls, be our guest.
lines.zh: : 要是你觉得跟一群[teenage]女孩一起听音乐玩很有意思，那就随便来。

lines.en: : Literally. Become our guest.
lines.zh: : 字面意思。来做我们的客人吧。

lines.en: : Simply arriving will net you a total of twenty more Nodoka points.
lines.zh: : 只要人到了，就能净赚整整二十点 Nodoka 点数。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall19
: Nodoka points? What’s a Nodoka point?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 点数？那是什么东西？

lines.en: : How many do I have and what can I do with them?
lines.zh: : 我有多少点，又能拿它们干什么？

lines.en: : It’s a currency I created up specifically for Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这是我专门为 Sensei 发明的一种货币。

lines.en: : I use them to determine how far along in our relationship we are.
lines.zh: : 我用它来衡量我们的关系进展到了哪一步。

lines.en: : That...kind of makes it sound like you have...ulterior motives.
lines.zh: : 这……听起来怎么像是你……别有用心。

lines.en: : Not at all. Everyone has a secret currency for everyone else whether they’re aware of it or not.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。每个人心里都有一套给别人的隐秘货币，只是自己未必意识到。

lines.en: : I’m sure that all of you have been slowly building up points with him in your heads as you experience new things together.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，你们也在脑子里一边跟他经历新鲜事，一边慢慢给他攒着点数。

lines.en: : I was just smart enough to assign a separate numeric value to mine so I can keep better track of them.
lines.zh: : 我只是聪明一点，给自己的点数单独标了数值，方便记账而已。

lines.en: : You’re making this impromptu point system sound a lot more logical than I’m sure it actually is.
lines.zh: : 你把这套临时想出来的点数系统说得比它实际的逻辑性强多了。

lines.en: : We’ll see if you’ll still be saying that when you go to cash them in some day.
lines.zh: : 等哪天你真来兑现的时候，看你还说不说得出口。

lines.en: scene dormeightfourhall20
: Welp, I’m lost. But if you want your Nodoka points or whatever, feel free to drop by.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我听晕了。不过如果你想要你的 Nodoka 点数什么的，随时来就是了。

lines.en: : I’m probably going to be spending my free time during the weekends just...scoping out new parks to play in or something if you ever want to come hang out for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我周末的空闲时间大概就在……到处踩点新公园去弹唱什么的，你要是哪天想来玩就来。

lines.en: : And I’ll be somewhere with many books. Doing book things.
lines.zh: : 而我会在书很多的地方。做些书的事。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be a writer? Where’s your clever word usage?
lines.zh: : 你不是自称作家吗？你那机智的用词呢？

lines.en: : Book thingies. Come to the reading place to say hi to the Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 书的东西呀。到看书写字的地方来跟 Nodoka 打招呼。

lines.en: : So the library. Got it.
lines.zh: : 也就是图书馆。明白了。

lines.en: : You’re fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 你他妈真是个怪人。

lines.en: : You love me already. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 你已经爱上我了。我能感觉到。

lines.en: scene black
I decide to let the four girls carry on the rest of their conversation without adult supervision and begin my journey away from the[school].
lines.zh: 我决定不打扰这四个女孩，让她们在没有成年人监督的情况下继续聊下去，自己也动身离开[school]。

lines.en: I’m not sure how I’m going to spend the rest of my night, but at least now I know that there is one more dorm room ready and willing to accept me with open arms.
lines.zh: 我还不知道今晚剩下的时间要怎么打发，但至少现在我清楚，又多了一间宿舍愿意张开双臂接纳我。

lines.en: Not like it would matter even if they weren’t.
lines.zh: 就算她们不愿意，其实也没什么区别。

lines.en: I’m sure I’d find a way in regardless because...
lines.zh: 反正我也总有办法进去的，因为……

lines.en: Well, that’s just the type of person I am.
lines.zh: 好吧，我就是这样的人。

lines.en: And having two more people who either accept that or simply don’t understand it yet-
lines.zh: 而又能多出两个人，要么接受这一点，要么干脆还没看懂——

lines.en: It’s a welcome change.
lines.zh: 这是值得欢迎的变化。

lines.en: Even if it’s a change I’ve been feeling time and time again lately.
lines.zh: 尽管这种变化我最近已经反复感受到过。

lines.en: Life sure is getting exciting, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 生活真是越来越精彩了，不是吗？
